summary: Build practical health supply chain and pharmaceutical logistics skills in 5 days. Learn stock control, cold chain, replenishment, and reporting.
lede: Health supply chain and pharmaceutical logistics coordinate the planning, storage and movement of medicines and other health commodities. This training is for professionals who manage, support or report on these flows and need to plan replenishment, maintain warehouse and cold-chain controls, and assess delivery performance. It covers consumption analysis, FEFO and batch traceability, distribution planning, and KPI reporting using inventory and logistics data.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage, support, or report on health commodity flows across procurement, storage, transport, and service delivery. It is especially useful if you handle stock records, warehouse controls, distribution planning, or logistics reporting in a health, pharmaceutical, NGO, or programme environment.
prerequisites: You should bring a working laptop, basic spreadsheet skills, and familiarity with stock records, warehouse registers, or distribution reports. If possible, bring sample LMIS extracts, inventory summaries, or delivery logs from your own work context.
